result.subject: Welcome to Our London Office – Tuesday 17 November
result.body:
Dear UK building society team,

We look forward to welcoming you on Tuesday 17 November at 09:30 for the QBR.

Our office is located at 3rd Floor, 21 Copper Row, London EC2A 4LT.

Upon arrival, please proceed to the ground‑floor reception, present photo ID to collect building passes, and note that the nearest stations are Liverpool Street (6 min walk) and Moorgate (8 min). Guest Wi‑Fi details will be displayed on the welcome screen in your meeting room.

You will be greeted by our VP Customer Success in the Boardroom.

Agenda:
- Welcome and introductions
- Quarter in review: service performance
- Roadmap update
- Priorities for next quarter

Kind regards,
Business Operations
